relevance.rationale: Establishes canonical veering taut ideal triangulations of punctured pseudo-Anosov mapping tori from periodic train-track splitting / Whitehead flip sequences.

keyResults.statement: Periodic splitting sequences of train tracks suited to the stable lamination of a punctured pseudo-Anosov map yield canonical veering taut ideal triangulations via Whitehead moves.
keyResults.useForFolio: Generalizes punctured-torus RL layering to arbitrary punctured surface mapping tori (covering fibered knots such as 4_1, while non-fibered 5_2 uses gueritaud2006 §9-10).
